Classes

From absolute beginners, improvers to advanced, we have the perfect class for your dance journey whatever the level. Join our vibrant Kizomba community every Tuesday night in Soho, London and dance the night away.

Why not spend your Tuesday evening learning Kizomba with us. We start with two hours of classes - one for every level - then we keep the music going at the social so you can practise what you've learnt, meet other dancers & be part of the family.
